as_told.title: Similar UFO radiation episode at Chernobyl written up by Jensen Andre

plain: At the height of the 1986 disaster at Chernobyl, the Soviet nuclear power plant in Ukraine, many people nearby saw a UFO arrive, stay for three minutes, shine a light at the reactor and leave. Michels tells this on several episodes, citing the writing of a Harvard PhD he names as Jensen Andreon. In one episode he says instead that radiation at the reactor tower was measured before and after, without mentioning the light. He puts it alongside other reports of UFOs at nuclear sites, which would suggest that something is watching nuclear facilities.
